MATCH (dd:DecisionDisposition) WHERE (dd.targetTdocNumber = tn OR dd IN byRel) AND coalesce(dd.evidenceStatus =~ '(?i) *(source[-_ ]?)?verified *', false)
WITH tn, dd, [(dd)-[:DISPOSITION_OF|HAS_DISPOSITION]-(r1:Resolution) | r1.resolutionScope] AS scopes
WHERE size(scopes) = 0 OR any(sc IN scopes WHERE NOT coalesce(sc =~ '(?i).*(partial|part[-_ ]of|portion|subset).*', false))
WITH tn, dd, [(:Tdoc {tdocNumber: tn})-[:HAS_CR|BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]-(p0:CRPack) | p0] + [(:CR {tdocNumber: tn})-[:HAS_CR|BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]-(p1:CRPack) | p1] AS pks
MATCH (pk:CRPack) WHERE pk IN pks
RETURN DISTINCT tn AS final_document, dd.dispositionCode AS disposition, pk.crPackId AS cr_pack

MATCH (pk0:CRPack)-[:HAS_CR|BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]-(c)
WHERE pk0.crPackId = 'RP-243073'
WITH DISTINCT c.tdocNumber AS tn
WHERE tn IS NOT NULL
WITH tn, [(dx:DecisionDisposition)-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(:Tdoc {tdocNumber: tn}) | dx] AS byRel
MATCH (dd:DecisionDisposition) WHERE (dd.targetTdocNumber = tn OR dd IN byRel) AND coalesce(dd.evidenceStatus =~ '(?i) *(source[-_ ]?)?verified *', false)
WITH tn, dd, [(dd)-[:DISPOSITION_OF|HAS_DISPOSITION]-(r1:Resolution) | r1.resolutionScope] AS scopes
WHERE size(scopes) = 0 OR any(sc IN scopes WHERE NOT coalesce(sc =~ '(?i).*(partial|part[-_ ]of|portion|subset).*', false))
WITH tn, dd, [(dd)-[:DISPOSITION_OF|HAS_DISPOSITION]-(r2:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m1:Meeting) WHERE NOT coalesce(r2.resolutionScope =~ '(?i).*(partial|part[-_ ]of|portion|subset).*', false) | m1] AS rm, [(:Tdoc {tdocNumber: tn})-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m2:Meeting) | m2] AS pm
WITH tn, dd, CASE WHEN size(rm) > 0 THEN rm ELSE pm END AS ms
MATCH (m:Meeting) WHERE m IN ms
RETURN DISTINCT tn AS document, dd.dispositionCode AS disposition, m.meetingNumber AS wg_meeting
